column1: # tank_fairness pass 10, master 67ad7c6a4, 2026-11-12: tankbench (go build -tags with_db ./tools/tankbench) -iters 3000 -seed 1 -encounter tools/encounters/<boss>.json tools/tankbench/req/<request>.json, six scoring bosses; score at the request's own weight (Max threat 1/3, Balanced 1, Max survival 3).
